# teams_work_load_policy_group_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a WorkLoadPolicy instance to an Entra group, with a rank among the type's group assignments, via Grant-CsTeamsWorkLoadPolicy -Group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Object id of the Entra group the policy is assigned to. Changing it forces replacement.
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the TeamsWorkLoadPolicy instance to assign to the group.
- `rank` (Number) One-based rank among the group assignments of TeamsWorkLoadPolicy; a user in several groups gets the policy of the lowest rank. Teams keeps ranks dense: assigning another group at an occupied rank shifts this one, which shows up as drift. A rank beyond the number of group assignments is placed last: the apply warns and the difference shows up as drift until the lower ranks exist, and an apply warns again while the rank stays beyond that number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment identifier (the group's object id).
